title: Change of variables for H^n under the blow-up map η_{x,r}
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, H := μHE[n] on ℝ^N, M ⊆ ℝ^N any set, φ : ℝ^N → ℝ any function, x ∈ ℝ^N and r > 0. Let η_{x,r}(z) = r⁻¹(z − x) (Chapter03.blowUpMap x r). Then ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} φ dH = r^{-n} ∫_M φ∘η_{x,r} dH (Bochner set integrals).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (φ : Euclidean N → ℝ) (x : Euclidean N) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∫ y in Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, φ y ∂μHE[n] = r⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ z in M, φ (Chapter03.blowUpMap x r z) ∂μHE[n]
